condition_monitoring_query_language.query:
fetch interconnect
| { metric 'interconnect.googleapis.com/network/interconnect/received_bytes_count'
    |  filter true() 
    | align rate(5m)
  ; metric 'interconnect.googleapis.com/network/interconnect/capacity'
    |  filter true() 
    | group_by 5m, [value_capacity_mean: mean(value.capacity)] }
| ratio
| every 5m
| scale '%'
| condition val() > 60 '%'

documentation.subject: Interconnect - Ingress Bandwidth Utilization above 60%
